entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Mm, that's good...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Maybe we should do this more often.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: How about you? Having fun?
This is the best.
So much fun.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Wow. I didn't know you were so[n]worked up about it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, maybe I can make this a little[n]more exciting.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Here's your present.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Not handmade or anything, okay?[n]Just so you know this wasn't some[n]huge labor of love.
Thanks.
I'll take good care of it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You can be pretty sweet sometimes.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmm...
Takemi is staring at me...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Got a chill down your spine?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You had cream on your nose.[n]No idea how it got there, but...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: As far as your other identity goes...[n]I figure it's not my business.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But as long as we're making this work[n]somehow, I might as well say this.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I can at least tell how much you and the[n]other Phantom Thieves go through[n]to save people.
The Phantom Thieves...
You can?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I am your girlfriend, after all.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I just wanted to acknowledge that...[n]it's thanks to those efforts that I found[n]my own calling.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I really am glad I've got you.
It was all you.
I didn't do anything.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Take a compliment for once.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Still, I gotta say... you've got some[n]weird taste.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: People talk, but what it comes down[n]to is that the Phantom Thieves are[n]these big modern heroes, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Never really thought of myself as[n]girlfriend material, let alone[n]for a hero.
I can't imagine anyone else.
You're the only one I want.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All right already.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Bring it down a notch, smooth talker.[n]Who are you trying to impress?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Whoa, look...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's really coming down out there.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I never fell for this stuff. All the snowfall,[n]the romance... I'm not exactly the[n]swooning type.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Didn't think I was, anyway.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Geez. I'm supposed to be the adult[n]here, but you're the one who keeps[n]supporting me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I've... never been happier.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: How about you? It's... good, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I feel like... I'm going to wake up[n]any second now, and all this will[n]be gone.
It's not a dream.
This is real.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're right. Maybe everything can[n]just be nice for once.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hey, I don't know if I should be[n]going home in all that snow.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You... get what I'm saying, right?
Takemi and I spent some[n]time alone together...
